module width_8to16(
    input clk, 
    input rst_n, 
    input valid_in, 
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output reg valid_out, 
    output reg [15:0] data_out
);
// Implementation goes here
    reg [7:0] data_lock;
    reg flag;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n)begin
            data_out <= 16'd0;
        end else begin
            if(valid_in && flag)begin
                data_out <= {data_lock,data_in};
            end
        end
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n)begin
            data_lock <= 8'd0;
        end else begin
            if(valid_in && !flag)begin
                data_lock <= data_in;
            end
        end
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n)begin
            flag <= 1'd0;
        end else begin
            if(valid_in)begin
                flag <= ~flag;
            end
        end
    end
    
    
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n)begin
            valid_out <= 1'd0;
        end else begin
            if((valid_in && flag))begin
                valid_out <= 1'd1;
            end else begin
                valid_out <= 1'd0;
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="width_8to16">
    <description>data width convertion circuit, 8bits to 16bits</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">clock signal</input>
        <input id="rst_n">active low reset signal</input>
        <input id="valid_in">indicates the validity of the input data</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data</input>
        <output id="valid_out">indicates the validity of the output data</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output data</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        //reg [15:0] data_out;
        reg [7:0] data_lock;
        reg flag;
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n)begin
                data_out <= 16'd0;
            end else begin
                if(valid_in && flag)begin
                    data_out <= {data_lock,data_in};
                end
            end
        end
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n)begin
                data_lock <= 8'd0;
            end else begin
                if(valid_in && !flag)begin
                    data_lock <= data_in;
                end
            end
        end
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n)begin
                flag <= 1'd0;
            end else begin
                if(valid_in)begin
                    flag <= ~flag;
                end
            end
        end
        
        
        assign valid_out = (valid_in && flag)? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    </implementation>
    
</module>
